item.title: Chhattisgarh: Rail connectivity reaches Rowghat; 1st since Independence
item.description: Rail connectivity reached Rowghat in Kanker district in Chhattisgarh’s Bastar for the first time since Independence on Tuesday, with the opening of the Tadoki-Rowghat railway section.
